pairs.english: Today he didn't have to.

pairs.target: sè lā tīng wán zhī wèn shǒu zěnyàng .
pairs.english: Sela heard him out and only asked about his hands.

pairs.target: tā bǎ luómào cóng zhǐ jiān gǔnluò de yàngzi bǐ gěi tā kàn ,
pairs.english: He showed her how the nut had rolled from his fingers,

Now he lay in bed,

pairs.target: yòng mǔzhǐ mō shízhǐ de zhǐ fù .
pairs.english: rubbing the pad of his forefinger with his thumb.

pairs.target: zuótiān nà céng gé zhe bù de gǎnjué dàn le ,
pairs.english: Yesterday's feeling of a layer of cloth between skin and things had faded,
pairs.hanzi: 昨天那层隔着布的感觉淡了，

pairs.english: but the sheet's coarse threads still felt indistinct.

pairs.english: He tried the other hand,

pairs.target: cái fāxiànzìjǐ yìzhí píng zhe qì .
pairs.english: only then realizing he'd been holding his breath.
pairs.hanzi: 才发现自己一直屏着气。

pairs.english: “Get up and eat,”
Sela said.

pairs.target: " mō yì zǎoshàng yě mō bùhǎo . "
pairs.english: “Feeling at it all morning won't make it better.”
On the table were a bowl of leftover beans
and two flatbreads.
After sitting down, Tavi

pairs.target: xiān bǎ wǎn wǎng zìjǐ zhèbiān nuó ,
pairs.english: first pulled the bowl towards himself.
Its base scraped the tabletop;
nothing spilled.

pairs.target: tā xiǎng ràng sè lā kànjiàn ,
pairs.english: He wanted Sela to notice,
then felt it was hardly an achievement
pairs.hanzi: 又觉得这不算什么本事，

pairs.english: and bent his head to eat.
Someone called from the door.

pairs.target: lái de shì nàtiān tì tā chǎn méizhā de gōngyǒu ,
pairs.english: It was the coworker who had helped shovel cinders that day,

pairs.english: a man named Ado.

pairs.target: tā dài zhe yìzhī liè le biān de táopén ,
pairs.english: He carried an earthenware bowl with a cracked rim,
pairs.hanzi: 他带着一只裂了边的陶盆，

pairs.target: gài zài shàngmiàn de pánzi yílù diān wāi ,

pairs.hanzi: 盖在上面的盘子一路颠歪，

pairs.english: so the aroma entered first.

pairs.target: " jiè nǐmen de zào rè yíxià bǐng .
pairs.english: “Let me warm my bread on your stove.

Sela took the bowl

pairs.target: wèn tā búshì shuō jīntiān yào bān chuáng .
pairs.english: and asked whether he'd said he was moving beds today.
pairs.hanzi: 问他不是说今天要搬床。

pairs.english: “Done already.
The bed by the window became available;

pairs.target: ā duó shuō dé xiàng yíng le shénme dàshì .

pairs.english: where anyone going out at night had to step over his feet.

pairs.english: The two broke open their bread
and tucked onions inside.
Ado took a bite,
so hot he opened his mouth to draw in air,
but refused to spit it out.
Tavi laughed
and pushed him a bowl of cool water.

pairs.target: " nài lěi nàbiān de huó ne ? "
pairs.english: “What about the work for Nerai?”
“Did it.
Half a day's rust,

pairs.target: zhān le wǒ liǎngtiān de bízi . "
pairs.english: two days stuck in my nose.”
Ado rubbed the tip of his nose.
“She paid on time.

pairs.target: tā wèn wǒ hái lái bu lái ,
pairs.english: She asked if I'd come back;

pairs.target: wǒ shuō dé kàn lú chǎng zěnme pái . "
pairs.english: I said it depended on the furnace yard's rota.”
“You didn't just agree?”
“I can't split myself in two.”

pairs.target: tā kànjiàn zhuō jiǎo de zhǐ ,

pairs.target: nà shàngmiàn shì lǔ cén liúxià de píngyǔ .

pairs.english: “No.
The academy assessment.
I didn't pass.”

pairs.target: tā shuō dé bǐ zuówǎn kuài .
pairs.english: He said it more quickly than last night.

pairs.target: ā duó shēn dào yíbàn de shǒu tíng le tíng ,

After moving the crates,

he said.

“When you've learned,
come back and tell me.

pairs.target: tā quèshí yǒu yìzhěngtiān zìjǐ de shì yào zuò .

pairs.english: The room grew quiet.

pairs.english: “You want to go,”

He stood behind the stool,

pairs.english: “I do.”

“Not just the lamp.”

pairs.english: He'd always said learning would let him earn more money;

pairs.english: that wasn't wrong,

pairs.english: But when Ado had asked just now,

“They set out two pieces of wood,
load them with two copper weights,

pairs.target: jiù néng zhīdào tiě zěnme dòng .
pairs.english: and can tell how the iron moves.
I handle these things every day,

pairs.target: què zhī huì shuō zhèkuài hǎo ,
pairs.english: yet all I can say is this piece is good,

Sela waited.
“I want to know for myself,”
he said,

pairs.target: " búshì měi huí dōu děng biérén gàosù wǒ . "
pairs.english: “instead of always waiting for someone else to tell me.”

pairs.english: and set the cooled beans beside the stove

pairs.english: before returning to sit at the table.

pairs.target: tā méiyǒu jiào tā bié xiǎng ,
pairs.english: She did not tell him to stop dreaming,

pairs.target: yě méiyǒu bǎ qián wǎn tuī gěi tā .
pairs.english: nor push the money bowl towards him.

pairs.target: " nà jiù bǎ liǎngjiànshì fēnkāi shuō .
pairs.english: “Then let's talk about the two things separately.
Wanting to learn
is wanting to learn.
One fewer person at home

Tavi pulled out the stool and sat.

pairs.target: tā cóng wǎn lǐ qǔchū jǐméi tóngqián ,
pairs.english: She took a few copper coins from the bowl,
pairs.hanzi: 她从碗里取出几枚铜钱，

pairs.english: leaving one in front of herself
and placing one in front of him,

pairs.target: zhōng jiàngé zhe nà zhāng hái méi qiānzì de zhǐ .
pairs.english: the still-unsigned paper between them.
pairs.hanzi: 中间隔着那张还没签字的纸。

pairs.target: " xiān bié suàn yǐhòu zhèng duōshǎo .
pairs.english: “Don't start with how much you'll earn later.
If you go,
whose wages are missing next month,
who carries the coal,
who brings the water?
For the help we can ask for,
what do we give in return?”
He looked at the two coins.

pairs.target: gébì de shuǐtǒng bùnéng yòng xuégōng de dēng lái tí ,

pairs.english: that much he understood.
“Let me set them out,”

pairs.target: sè lā bǎ wǎn tuī dào zhuōzi zhōngyāng .

pairs.english: He slowly eased out the next coin with a fingernail,
pairs.hanzi: 他用指甲慢慢拨出下一枚，

pairs.target: zhè yícì méiyǒu jí zhe ràng tā kàn .
pairs.english: this time in no hurry to have her notice.
